description_en: You can call DescribeDcdnWafRules to query the details of configured protection rules
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnWafRules查询用户已配置的防护规则详细信息
name: DescribeDcdnWafRules

parameters.help_en:
The query conditions. This parameter is a JSON string.

If you do not specify this parameter, all protection rules are queried
parameters.help_zh:
查询条件，JSON序列化后的字符串。
格式如下：```QueryArgs={"PolicyIds":"防护策略ID范围","RuleIds":"防护规则ID范围","RuleNameLike":"防护规则名称","DomainNames":"防护域名","DefenseScenes":"waf_group","RuleStatus":"on","OrderBy":"GmtModified","Desc":"false"}```
不传默认查询所有防护规则
parameters.name: query_args

parameters.help_en: The page number. The default value is 1. Valid values: 1 to 100000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of protection rules to return on each page. The default value is 20. Valid values: an integer from 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的防护规则个数，默认值20，取值范围：1~500之间的任意整数
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page. This value is the same as the \`PageNumber\` request parameter

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page. This value is the same as the \`PageSize\` request parameter
PageSize.description_zh: 每页显示的防护规则个数，同请求参数中PageSize

Rules.description_en: The details of the protection rules

DefenseScene.description_en: The type of the mitigation setting. This value is the same as the \`DefenseScene\` field in the \`QueryArgs\` request parameter
DefenseScene.description_zh: 防护策略类型，同请求参数QueryArgs中的DefenseScene

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the rule was last modified. The time is in the \`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ\` format and is displayed in UTC
GmtModified.description_zh: 修改时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the mitigation policy

RuleConfig.description_en: The configuration details of the protection rule

RuleId.description_en: The ID of the protection rule

RuleName.description_en: The name of the protection rule

RuleStatus.description_en: The status of the protection rule. This value is the same as the \`RuleStatus\` field in the \`QueryArgs\` request parameter
RuleStatus.description_zh: 防护规则状态，同请求参数QueryArgs中RuleStatus

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of protection rules
